description: Search current Norwegian laws and central regulations from Lovdata by words in the title or in the section text, optionally by type and ministry. Title matches rank first; each result carries up to three matching section snippets, not the full text. Costs 0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

ministry.description: Part of the ministry name, e.g. Justis.

q.description: Up to 8 words; all must appear in the title, or all in one section. Leave out to list documents.

type.description: Only laws (lov) or only central regulations (forskrift).

name: search_laws
title: Search Norwegian laws and regulations
